message.text: I'm getting 401 Unauthorized errors when calling my API. The JWT token should be valid but keeps getting rejected by the middleware.
The token is definitely fresh — I just generated it. Could the middleware configuration be wrong?
How should I set the Authorization header with bearer token correctly when making requests?
My handleAuthError middleware isn't catching 401s from nested Express router routes
Should I refresh the token automatically when I get a 401?
